text:
Alex W: heads-up — I merged the module refactor PR (GH #4821). main changes: split `aws/providers` into per-module provider blocks + bumped module versions. Can folks quick-check pinning/lockfile implications?
Maya R: nice, thx. did you regen the .terraform.lock.hcl?
Alex W: not yet — wanted to get eyes on provider pins first. plan showed provider mismatches in staging, so paused apply.
Sam T: ok — two things i care about: state moves (any resources renamed?) and k8s secret path wiring for the credentials module.
Alex W: no resource renames, just module interfaces shifted (inputs moved under module.xyz). For k8s secrets: the module now expects `secret_path` to be the full k8s path, not just name. might break some envs.
Jamie L: can you paste the failing plan snippet? small grep-able output helps.
Alex W: sure — from staging plan: 
```
# module.eks.module.kube_config.null_resource.update[0] will be replaced
-/+ resource "kubernetes_secret" "creds" {
    - metadata {
        - name = "redwood-creds" -> null
      }
    + metadata {
        + name = "redwood-creds" # forces replacement
      }
  }
```
Maya R: that replacement is because provider addresses changed? or because input path changed causing diff?
Alex W: it's the input shape — module now concatenates namespace and name, old configs passed just name so plan thinks name changed.
Sam T: OK — that suggests we need a small compatibility shim in the module: if `secret_path` contains `/` treat as full path else prefix with default namespace. quick patch & regen lockfile should avoid replacement.
CI Bot: terraform plan for branch refs/4821 failed: provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/kubernetes: required version ~> 2.11.0, found 2.10.1 in lockfile.
Maya R: exactly — lockfile needs bump to include the kubernetes provider 2.11.0. that explains plan failure in CI.
Jamie L: who can run `terraform providers lock` in staging workspace? must do with same terraform version used in CI (1.5.6).
Alex W: i can run it in staging tomorrow morning and push regenerated lockfile + the shim patch. will open a follow-up PR.
Sam T: also add a short changelog note in the module README about the `secret_path` shape change and a migration snippet: `old: secret = "redwood-creds"` -> `new: secret_path = "default/redwood-creds"` to avoid surprise.
Maya R: +1. and add a lint to the module CI that fails if `secret_path` is empty to catch accidental breakage.
Jamie L: for canary rollout: recommend apply to staging, then a canary in prod namespace `canary-1` with `count = 1` for a day. if nothing explodes, full roll.
Alex W: sounds good. plan: 1) add shim + README note 2) regen lockfile with terraform 1.5.6 3) push PR and run staging apply 4) canary in prod namespace. I'll ping when PR is up.
Maya R: thanks — ping me for review, i'll check secret wiring tests. :thumbsup:
Sam T: echo — i'll watch state-move fallout.
CI Bot: note: please ensure provider mirrors (internal registry) accept 2.11.0, otherwise CI downloads may fail behind firewall.
Alex W: adding vendor check to the PR description. will update thread when lockfile is pushed.
